offer.text: I am assembling a small library. Three bound books would be a fine start — could you spare them?

accept.text: Splendid. A village with books is a village with a future.

decline.text: Another day, perhaps, when the shelves call to you.

ready.text: Three volumes! These will be read and re-read for years.

complete.text: You have my lasting gratitude, friend.
